items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Hershel Evans. All them tenor saxes. All of them artists.

ctx.x: See, I think you're an artist.

Eddie Durham, Eddie Barefield, Ben Webster. All of them cats. Hershel Evans. All them tenor saxes. All of them artists. And mostly every guy that can play a lot of music, you just watch... I don't care what kind of an instrument he played. He's always quiet. He's not rowdy.
